# Ecuador

> [!summary] Data available
> Small but unusual coverage: it has a [[BLEnD]] culture (`Spanish_Ecuador`, 105 food questions, 492 answer clusters), plus [[WorldCuisines]] 16 and [[FmLAMA]] 8 dishes and 37 [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]] recipes. No FCT; plants via [[CMAUP]] (142) and [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]] (56).

## Foods & dishes
- [[BLEnD]] `Spanish_Ecuador` (SemEval-2026): 105 food questions, 492 food answer clusters; the only Spanish-language Latin American BLEnD culture.
- Dish inventories: [[WorldCuisines]] 16 dishes (2 Ecuador-only); [[FmLAMA]] 8 dishes (e.g. llapingacho, seco, tripa mishki).
- [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]]: 37 recipes tagged `ecuadorean`; [[RecipeDB2]] ≈20 in v1.
- Backlog: [[RecetasDeLaAbuela]] (priority 3, open-download): Spanish-language recipes labelled by Spanish-speaking country; per-country counts not known yet.

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national food composition table in the vault or `Backlog/`; [[USDA FoodData Central]] is the fallback.
- Plants: [[CMAUP]] 142 plants; [[NPASS]] 10 specimen pairs.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]]: 56 ethnobotany records, 34 taxa. [[KNApSAcK Family]] has a World-map page for it (edible/medicinal species records), not scraped, so no count in the vault.
- Compound → effect chains via the [[Global]] backbones ([[FooDB]], [[CTD]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[SpiceRx]]).

## Gaps
- No Ecuadorian FCT and no recipe set with amounts.
- BLEnD answers give everyday food knowledge but no ingredients or nutrients.
